limitations: Only twelve cross-domain pairs have preliminary labels from one developer; eleven are negative and one is positive.
The BAS threshold was fitted to same-task rather than same-narrow-line labels and is not calibrated for these domains.
The twenty cross-domain holdout pairs remain unlabelled and are not sent to the model or scored; they reside in the same frozen packet file.
A passing diagnostic does not establish scientific quality, independent accuracy, or production readiness.
